data.title: 拉·芙利亚 · 邮轮套房的白银军服从容浅酌
data.description: 豪华邮轮全景贵宾套房内，华灯初上，落地窗外是泛着粼粼波光的浩瀚海景。拉·芙利亚身着一袭尊贵的阿尔迪基亚亲卫白银军服，军装外套前襟轻展，金色肩章在暖光下生辉。银白长发如月光流淌在肩后，她侧坐在丝绒贵妃榻上，指尖执着剔透的水晶香槟杯，蔚蓝眼眸流转着王族特有的端庄与不加掩饰的深情。
data.location: luxurious cruise ship grand suite overlooking starry night ocean
data.action: seated gracefully on plush velvet chaise lounge, immaculate white royal military parade jacket loosely unbuttoned at collar, gold fringed epaulets, short skirt, holding crystal champagne flute, flowing silver hair, regal captivating smile
data.lighting: warm crystal chandelier glow mixing with deep indigo ocean moonlight
data.mood: regal romantic allure, sophisticated royal warmth
data.promptProse: Inside a luxury cruise suite, Princess La Folia lounges gracefully on a velvet chaise wearing her white royal military uniform with loosened collar and gold epaulets. Holding a champagne glass, her silver hair flows as she smiles with regal, captivating affection.
data.animaCaption: Princess La Folia in an open white royal uniform holding champagne in a cruise suite, smiling charmingly.
